feature_contract.goal: Restore the complete VR ESC/pause menu shell and option arrows to readable binocular optical size across 4:3, 16:9, 21:9 source images and Quest3 portrait eyes while retaining centered native shape and original pause navigation.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only the exact native ESC pause sprite owner when responsive HUD is enabled; exclude gameplay HUD, F11 external overlay, original main/car-select menus, world stereo, SkyGlow, lens rings, FFB and all DX11/DXVK/localization branches.
trace_stages: The original OutRun ESC pause/menu state emits shell and option-arrow sprite geometry independently of F11 and the gameplay HUD.
The R30IsPauseMenuElement semantic predicate classifies the exact pause Draw owner and R30HudContainScale caches optical containment per Present.
R30HudAspectCompensation maps the native source aspect into live OpenXR per-eye recommended extents and applies equal optical magnification without stretching the menu or changing other Draw owners.
subcomponents: Add finite bounded geometric-mean portrait-eye magnification to the single shared pause shell-and-arrows optical scale with existing source/eye ratio compensation.
Include pause semantic ownership in the per-Present HUD containment cache identity so rapid ESC entry/exit cannot borrow ordinary HUD scale.
Exercise 4:3, 16:9, 21:9, Quest3 extents, desktop/legacy opt-out and broken path negative mutations using existing C++ smoke and Python source guard.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Native ESC pause shell and arrows receive one bounded portrait-eye optical enlargement, retain matching X/Y aspect and are sized on both eyes without adopting gameplay HUD scale.
Responsive opt-out, original desktop/UI, F11, world and gameplay HUD retain their existing transforms, while pause-owner cache identity prevents stale menu scale reuse across ESC changes.

Focused C++ smoke, destructive regression mutations, DX9Ex Active policy/game/host/full-chain/package and Domain Isolation on the same validation-bearing source SHA succeed; HMD visual acceptance remains separate.

diagnosis.original_evidence: User's Quest3/VDXR 2026-10-13 test of exact build 75ef9c91 reports the native ESC pause menu much too small and upward shifted at 3440x1440 source, XR recommended per-eye 2496x2688.
source_trace: Native OutRun pause-state producer emits ESC shell and arrows rather than the external ImGui F11 owner.
R30IsPauseMenuElement gates the pause sprite semantic while R30HudContainScale derives shared binocular scale and memoizes per-Present state.
Source/eye aspect compensation, original sprite screen position and OpenXR host composition determine visible left/right-eye pause extent.
diagnosis.root_cause: Original HUD source-to-eye contain shrinks native pause controls on portrait eye displays and reuses common scaling even though the pause menu needs independent optical-size ownership; pause semantics were not previously a containment cache key.
alternatives_rejected: A global R30 HudScale increase would also magnify gameplay HUD and F11 and risk the known-good world/UI paths.
Separate X and Y arbitrary scaling would distort the shell and arrow layout and worsen navigation hitbox correspondence.
Changing SkyGlow and world projection cannot fix a native ESC sprite-only geometric issue.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Only responsive native ESC sprite owner and its associated option arrows may use the enlarged but aspect-preserving common binocular optical containment; leave per-eye world projections and F11 external draws unchanged.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Existing smoke adds Quest3 3440x1440→2496x2688 and 4:3/16:9/21:9 bounded monotonic expectations; Python source guard performs independent cache/owner/scaling destructive mutations and preserves legacy opt-out.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Existing task material SHA 0b8d84ff54cec5bd6da5fe254c37ae71ac6d9829 modifies native pause scaling helper, R30 Draw containment and focused C++/Python tests.
diagnosis.repair_evidence: Prior DX9Ex Active 38491931096 failed solely in policy: missing docs/automation/runs/CONVERSION-DX9EX-00812.json prevented game/host/full-chain/package stages. This resumed run restores required feature record for policy verification.
